channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Could Iran war trigger a hunger crisis?
item.description: The UN warns disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz could drive up food and fertiliser costs, and worsen global hunger.

item.title: ‘China is gaining from what the US is doing in Iran’
item.description: Geopolitical analyst Steve Okun says says China is benefiting from the war on Iran.

item.title: Iran’s FM urges BRICS states to condemn US-Israeli aggression
item.description: Iran’s Foreign Minister, Abbas Araghchi, spoke at a gathering of foreign ministers in New Delhi on Thursday.

item.title: Iran, Taiwan, and trade: Trump’s high‑stakes return to Beijing
item.description: As Trump meets Xi in Beijing for the first time in nine years, can trade war, Taiwan and Iran tensions be contained?

item.title: What does the US hope to achieve from Lebanon-Israel talks?
item.description: As Israeli attacks on Lebanon continue, Hezbollah opposes ceasefire talks in Washington.

item.title: Iran expands tiered internet access amid continued online blackout
item.description: Iranians have had limited internet access during the war, with the government now looking at tiered services.

item.title: Iran urges BRICS nations to condemn US-Israeli war aggression
item.description: Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi also accused the UAE of direct involvement in military operations against Iran.

item.title: 'Floating armoury' ship reportedly seized by Iran
item.description: A vessel said to be a “floating armoury” in the Gulf of Oman has been seized by Iranian military personnel, according to reports.

item.title: Ukraine rescuers pull dead from rubble of Kyiv flats after massive Russian strikes
item.description: Two children are among at least 16 killed in Ukraine's capital in massive Russian drone and missile attacks, officials say.

item.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill 22 people, health ministry says
item.description: Eight children are among those reported dead after a series of air strikes hit the south of Beirut.
